subject: POC Kickoff & Hands-on Prompt Workshop — Scheduling and Agenda
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — suggested dates and workshop scope

Hi Marissa / team,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the product looked promising. We'd like to kick off a short POC that focuses on prompt review and routing (to ensure quality) and run some lightweight load tests at the end to validate throughput. Can we schedule a POC kickoff + hands-on prompt workshop next week? Our preferred windows are:

- Tue, Jun 16: afternoon (PT)
- Wed, Jun 17: morning (PT)
- Thu, Jun 18: morning (PT)

Goals for the 2-hour workshop: prompt inventory, guardrails and structured output requirements, routing/variant selection, and a quick load test plan.

I've attached a one-pager with Acme's goals and the internal stakeholder list (attachment: Acme_POC_brief.pdf). Let me know which slot works and who from Redwood should join.

Cheers,
Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Product
AcmeAI
[attachment: Acme_POC_brief.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeai.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — suggested dates and workshop scope

Hi Alex — great to hear and thanks for the brief. Wed, Jun 17 in the morning should work for our team. Proposed time: 10:00–12:00 PT.

Attendees from Redwood: myself (sales/POC lead), Dev (solutions engineer), Neha (inference engineer), and Rachel (CS).

I attached a draft agenda and a prompt inventory template to collect your team's prompt examples ahead of time — can you share the inventory filled out before the session? That will make the hands-on part much more productive.

Draft agenda (attached: POC_Agenda_v1.pdf):
- 10:00–10:15 Intro / goals / success criteria
- 10:15–11:00 Prompt inventory review and guardrail requirements
- 11:00–11:25 Structured output & routing (variants / fallbacks)
- 11:25–11:50 Load test plan and quick smoke run approach
- 11:50–12:00 Next steps / action items

Prework: please fill out the Prompt_Inventory_Template.xlsx with 8–12 representative prompts and expected structured outputs.

If that time works I'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales Lead
Redwood Inference
[attachment: POC_Agenda_v1.pdf]
[attachment: Prompt_Inventory_Template.xlsx]

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeai.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — suggested dates and workshop scope

Quick note — Jun 17 morning works for me; prefer 10:00–12:00 PT (so my east-coast block after lunch is free). For the load tests: I recommend we do a short smoke load test (30m) at the end of the session to validate routing and latency, and schedule a separate full throughput run (1–2 hours) later that day or the next morning when we can allocate a dedicated instance.

I'll prepare a short checklist (prompt payload sizes, token budgets, routing rules to exercise) and bring a couple of example quantization / batch settings to discuss.

— Dev
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — suggested dates and workshop scope

Thanks — Jun 17 10:00–12:00 PT works for us. Confirming attendees from Acme: myself, Mike Chen (platform), and Sara Wu (ML).

Question: are we planning to do the smoke load test inside the two-hour workshop or do you prefer a short smoke during the call and a separate throughput run later? Either is fine, we just want to make sure we have capacity and the right folks on the call.

I'll ask Mike to share a list of example prompts and expected outputs in the Drive link you sent.

Best,
Alex
[signature]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeai.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — invited: Jun 17 10:00–12:00 PT (POC kickoff + prompt workshop)

Alex — invite sent (attached .ics).

Agenda (final):
- 10:00–10:15 Introductions, success criteria, roles
- 10:15–11:00 Prompt inventory deep dive (we'll annotate prompts for guardrails and structured outputs)
- 11:00–11:25 Routing & variant strategy (model variants, fallback policies, latency/cost tradeoffs)
- 11:25–11:50 Smoke load test plan (we'll run a 10–15 minute smoke during the session to validate routing; schedule separate full throughput run if needed)
- 11:50–12:00 Action items and next steps (ownership + timeline)

Pre-reqs for Acme: please upload 8–12 representative prompts to the shared Drive doc and indicate expected structured outputs (JSON schema or fields). If you have sample payload sizes and concurrency targets, add those as well — this will help Dev plan the smoke test parameters.

Attachments: invite-20260617.ics, POC_Agenda_v1.pdf, Prompt_Inventory_Template.xlsx

See you on Jun 17 at 10 PT.

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales Lead, Redwood Inference

Alex / team — quick follow-up before the workshop: thanks for confirming attendees. Two quick asks before Friday EOD:

1) Drop the filled Prompt_Inventory_Template.xlsx into the shared Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPOCMaterials (we'll review during the session).
2) Add expected concurrency (e.g., 5, 20, 50 concurrent requests) and average prompt length (tokens) in the sheet so Dev can size the smoke run.

We'll also post a short pre-read in the Drive with the agenda and a checklist. Reach out if you need to shift the time.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Customer Success
Redwood Inference
